config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT round(sum(duration_count)) AS Runs FROM (SELECT t, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint))

SELECT round(sum(duration_count) * 86400 / greatest(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime), 1)) AS `Runs/Day` FROM (SELECT t, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint))

tiles.name: Runs vs prev week (%)

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT ifNull(round(100 * ((SELECT v FROM (SELECT sum(duration_count) AS v FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint))) - (SELECT v FROM (SELECT sum(duration_count) AS v FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)))) / nullIf((SELECT v FROM (SELECT sum(duration_count) AS v FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint))), 0), 1), 0) AS `Runs vs prev week`

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT round(100 * (sum(errors) + sumIf(issues, flow_type != 'http')) / sum(runs), 1) AS `Err Rate`
FROM (SELECT t, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, 0 AS issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT t, flow_type, 0 AS runs, 0 AS errors, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint))

SELECT count() AS Sessions FROM (SELECT instance FROM (SELECT t, instance, duration_count AS runs FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, instance, duration_count AS runs FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, instance, duration_count AS runs FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint))
GROUP BY instance HAVING sum(runs) > 0)

SELECT round(1e3 * dur / runs, 1) AS `Avg` FROM (SELECT sum(duration_sum) AS dur, sum(duration_count) AS runs, sumMap(buckets) AS bk
FROM (SELECT t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)))

WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,
  arrayFirst((v, c) -> c >= q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1],
    arrayMap((k, n, c) -> exp2((k + 1 - (c - q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1]) / n) / 4),
      mapKeys(buckets), mapValues(buckets), arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))),
    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile
SELECT round(1e3 * hud_duration_quantile(0.9, bk), 1) AS `P90` FROM (SELECT sum(duration_sum) AS dur, sum(duration_count) AS runs, sumMap(buckets) AS bk
FROM (SELECT t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)))

WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,
  arrayFirst((v, c) -> c >= q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1],
    arrayMap((k, n, c) -> exp2((k + 1 - (c - q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1]) / n) / 4),
      mapKeys(buckets), mapValues(buckets), arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))),
    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile
SELECT round(1e3 * hud_duration_quantile(0.99, bk), 1) AS `P99` FROM (SELECT sum(duration_sum) AS dur, sum(duration_count) AS runs, sumMap(buckets) AS bk
FROM (SELECT t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)))

WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,
  arrayFirst((v, c) -> c >= q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1],
    arrayMap((k, n, c) -> exp2((k + 1 - (c - q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1]) / n) / 4),
      mapKeys(buckets), mapValues(buckets), arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))),
    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile
SELECT round(1e3 * hud_duration_quantile(1, bk), 1) AS `P100` FROM (SELECT sum(duration_sum) AS dur, sum(duration_count) AS runs, sumMap(buckets) AS bk
FROM (SELECT t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)))

SELECT round(dur / 60, 2) AS `Dur Total` FROM (SELECT sum(duration_sum) AS dur, sum(duration_count) AS runs, sumMap(buckets) AS bk
FROM (SELECT t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)))

SELECT if(lg.exc = '', m.fp, if(lg.fn = '', lg.exc, concat(lg.exc, ' in ', lg.fn))) AS Issue, left(splitByChar('\n', lg.msg)[1], 120) AS Message,
    m.result AS Result, round(sum(m.n)) AS Occurrences, m.fp AS Fingerprint, ${env:sqlstring} AS Env
FROM (SELECT fingerprint AS fp, framework_result AS result, sum(issues) AS n
      FROM (SELECT t, fingerprint, framework_result, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, fingerprint, framework_result, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, fingerprint, framework_result, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)) GROUP BY fp, result) AS m
LEFT JOIN (SELECT LogAttributes['issue.fingerprint'] AS fp, argMax(JSONExtractString(Body, 'exceptions', 1, 'name'), Timestamp) AS exc,
          argMax(JSONExtractString(Body, 'exceptions', 1, 'executionFlow', 1, 'function', 'code.function.name'), Timestamp) AS fn,
          argMax(JSONExtractString(Body, 'exceptions', 1, 'message'), Timestamp) AS msg
      FROM hud_otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND EventName = 'hud.forensic' AND LogAttributes['hud.forensic.type'] = 'error'
      AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'], $env) GROUP BY fp) AS lg ON lg.fp = m.fp
WHERE m.n > 0 GROUP BY m.fp, m.result, lg.exc, lg.fn, lg.msg ORDER BY Occurrences DESC

SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, sum(duration_count) / greatest(1, dateDiff('second', ts, least(ts + toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600))), least(toStartOfInterval($__toTime - INTERVAL 1 SECOND, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, 1, 3600))) + toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, 1, 3600)), now())))) AS `Runs/s` FROM (SELECT t, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts WITH FILL FROM toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) TO $__toTime STEP toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))

SELECT JSONExtractString(Body, 'exceptions', 1, 'name') AS Exception, JSONExtractString(Body, 'exceptions', 1, 'executionFlow', 1, 'function', 'code.function.name') AS Function, count() AS Count FROM hud_otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND EventName = 'hud.forensic' AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'], $env) AND LogAttributes['hud.forensic.type'] = 'error' AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(LogAttributes['code.flow.name'], $endpoint) GROUP BY Exception, Function ORDER BY Count DESC

WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,
  arrayFirst((v, c) -> c >= q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1],
    arrayMap((k, n, c) -> exp2((k + 1 - (c - q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1]) / n) / 4),
      mapKeys(buckets), mapValues(buckets), arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))),
    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile
SELECT ts, 1e3 * dur / runs AS Avg, 1e3 * hud_duration_quantile(0.9, bk) AS P90, 1e3 * hud_duration_quantile(0.99, bk) AS P99, 1e3 * hud_duration_quantile(1, bk) AS P100
FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, sum(duration_sum) AS dur, sum(duration_count) AS runs, sumMap(buckets) AS bk
      FROM (SELECT t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)) GROUP BY ts HAVING runs > 0)
ORDER BY ts

SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, 100 * (sum(errors) + sumIf(issues, flow_type != 'http')) / nullIf(sum(runs), 0) AS `Err Rate`
FROM (SELECT t, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, 0 AS issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT t, flow_type, 0 AS runs, 0 AS errors, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, issues FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

tiles.name: Latest forensics (click a Forensic id for its page)

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT LogAttributes['issue.fingerprint'] AS Forensic, Timestamp AS time, LogAttributes['hud.forensic.type'] AS Trigger, LogAttributes['code.flow.name'] AS Flow, LogAttributes['http.response.status_code'] AS Status, round(JSONExtractFloat(Body, 'duration') / 1e6, 1) AS `Duration ms`, JSONExtractString(Body, 'exceptions', 1, 'name') AS Exception, JSONExtractString(Body, 'exceptions', 1, 'executionFlow', 1, 'function', 'code.function.name') AS Function, JSONExtractString(Body, 'exceptions', 1, 'executionFlow', 1, 'caller', 'code.function.name') AS Caller, LogAttributes['hud.issue.caught'] AS Caught, JSONExtractString(Body, 's3_pointer') AS `Forensic (S3)`, ${env:sqlstring} AS Env FROM hud_otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND EventName = 'hud.forensic' AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'], $env) AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(LogAttributes['code.flow.name'], $endpoint) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, 1e3 * sum(e2e_sum) / nullIf(sum(e2e_count), 0) AS `E2E avg ms`, sum(messages) / greatest(1, dateDiff('second', ts, least(ts + toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600))), least(toStartOfInterval($__toTime - INTERVAL 1 SECOND, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, 1, 3600))) + toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, 1, 3600)), now())))) AS `Messages/s`
FROM (SELECT t, e2e_sum, e2e_count, 0 AS messages FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT t, 0 AS e2e_sum, 0 AS e2e_count, messages FROM hud_otel.endpoint_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, e2e_sum, e2e_count, messages FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)) GROUP BY ts HAVING sum(e2e_count) > 0 OR sum(messages) > 0 ORDER BY ts

SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, 100 * sum(cpu_sum) / nullIf(sum(cpu_count), 0) AS Avg, 100 * maxIf(cpu_max, cpu_count > 0) AS Max
FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT t, t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT * EXCEPT hour, hour AS t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY ts HAVING sum(cpu_count) > 0 ORDER BY ts

SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, 100 * sum(elu_sum) / nullIf(sum(elu_count), 0) AS Avg, 100 * maxIf(elu_max, elu_count > 0) AS Max
FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT t, t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT * EXCEPT hour, hour AS t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY ts HAVING sum(elu_count) > 0 ORDER BY ts

SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, 100 * (sum(memory_sum) / sum(memory_count)) / avgIf(memory_limit, memory_limit > 0) AS Avg,
    100 * maxIf(memory_max, memory_count > 0) / avgIf(memory_limit, memory_limit > 0) AS Max
FROM (SELECT * EXCEPT t, t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)
  UNION ALL SELECT * EXCEPT hour, hour AS t FROM hud_otel.process_metrics_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service)) GROUP BY ts HAVING sum(memory_count) > 0 ORDER BY ts

SELECT if(code = '', 'no status code', code) AS `Status Code`, round(tn) AS Count, round(100 * tn / sum(tn) OVER (), 1) AS `Distribution %`,
    round(1000 * td / tn, 1) AS `Avg ms`
FROM (SELECT status_code AS code, sum(duration_count) AS tn, sum(duration_sum) AS td
      FROM (SELECT t, status_code, duration_count, duration_sum FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, status_code, duration_count, duration_sum FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, status_code, duration_count, duration_sum FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)) GROUP BY code HAVING tn > 0)
ORDER BY Count DESC

WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,
  arrayFirst((v, c) -> c >= q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1],
    arrayMap((k, n, c) -> exp2((k + 1 - (c - q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1]) / n) / 4),
      mapKeys(buckets), mapValues(buckets), arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))),
    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile
SELECT multiIf(ff = '', 'no flags', ff = '__hud_other__', 'other combinations', ff) AS `Feature flags`, round(tn) AS Runs,
    round(100 * tn / sum(tn) OVER (), 1) AS `Distribution %`, round(100 * (te + tio) / tn, 1) AS `Err Rate (%)`,
    round(1000 * td / tn, 1) AS `Avg ms`, round(1e3 * hud_duration_quantile(0.9, tb), 1) AS `P90 ms`, round(ti) AS Issues
FROM (SELECT feature_flags AS ff, sum(runs) AS tn, sum(errors) AS te, sumIf(issues, flow_type != 'http') AS tio,
          sum(issues) AS ti, sum(dur) AS td, sumMap(bk) AS tb
      FROM (SELECT t, flow_type, feature_flags, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, 0 AS issues, duration_sum AS dur, buckets AS bk FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT t, flow_type, feature_flags, 0 AS runs, 0 AS errors, issues, 0 AS dur, map() AS bk FROM hud_otel.endpoint_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, flow_type, feature_flags, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, issues, duration_sum AS dur, buckets AS bk FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, flow_type, feature_flags, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, issues, duration_sum AS dur, buckets AS bk FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint))
      GROUP BY ff HAVING tn > 0)
ORDER BY Runs DESC

tiles.name: Functions in this flow, by Dur Total (click one for its page)

config.sqlTemplate:
WITH (q, buckets) -> if(empty(buckets), nan,
  arrayFirst((v, c) -> c >= q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1],
    arrayMap((k, n, c) -> exp2((k + 1 - (c - q * arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))[-1]) / n) / 4),
      mapKeys(buckets), mapValues(buckets), arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets))),
    arrayCumSum(mapValues(buckets)))) AS hud_duration_quantile
SELECT function AS Function, round(runs) AS Runs, round(runs * 24 / greatest(intDiv({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}, 3600000) - intDiv({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}, 3600000), 1)) AS `Runs/Day`, round(ifNull(100 * (cur - prev) / nullIf(prev, 0), 0), 1) AS `Runs vs prev week %`, round(100 * errs / runs, 1) AS `Err Rate %`, round(dur / 60, 2) AS `Dur Total (min)`, if(empty(bk), NULL, round(1000 * hud_duration_quantile(0.9, bk), 1)) AS `P90 ms`, if(cnt = 0, NULL, round(1000 * dur / cnt, 1)) AS `Avg ms`, if(empty(bk), NULL, round(1000 * hud_duration_quantile(1, bk), 1)) AS `P100 ms`, service AS Service, flow AS Flow, ${env:sqlstring} AS Env
FROM (SELECT service, flow, function, sum(calls) AS runs, sum(errors) AS errs, sum(duration_sum) AS dur, sum(duration_count) AS cnt, sumMap(buckets) AS bk
      FROM (SELECT t, service, flow, function, 0 AS calls, 0 AS errors, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.function_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT t, service, flow, function, calls, errors, 0 AS duration_sum, 0 AS duration_count, CAST(map(), 'Map(Int16, UInt64)') AS buckets FROM hud_otel.function_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, flow, function, calls, errors, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, flow, function, calls, errors, duration_sum, duration_count, buckets FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)) GROUP BY service, flow, function) AS m
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, flow, function, sum(calls) AS cur FROM (SELECT service, flow, function, calls FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_lean_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)) GROUP BY service, flow, function) AS c USING (service, flow, function)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, flow, function, sum(calls) AS prev FROM (SELECT service, flow, function, calls FROM hud_otel.function_metrics_lean_1h WHERE hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR > $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND hour + INTERVAL 1 HOUR <= $__toTime - INTERVAL 1 WEEK AND $__filter(env, $env) AND $__filter(service, $service) AND $__filter(flow, $endpoint)) GROUP BY service, flow, function) AS p USING (service, flow, function)
WHERE runs > 0
ORDER BY dur DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT Timestamp AS time, ServiceName AS serviceName, LogAttributes['hud.forensic.type'] AS `hud.forensic.type`, LogAttributes['code.flow.name'] AS `code.flow.name`, Body AS body FROM hud_otel.otel_logs WHERE Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND Timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND EventName = 'hud.forensic' AND $__filter(ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'], $env) AND $__filter(ServiceName, $service) AND $__filter(LogAttributes['code.flow.name'], $endpoint) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
